imagine that you live in a great kingdom with a king and queen and many other great people. you hear that the king's son is going to get married and there will be a great wedding feast. all the lords and ladies and rich landowners are invited. on the day of the wedding the servants go out to call the guests to the wedding, but all those important people refuse to go! they busy" with other things, and can't be bothered to go! now imagine that you are one of the children in a poor family that lives down a back street. suddenly you hear people calling out that the king has invited your family to the feast! what excitement! everybody puts on their best clothes and goes to the castle. you hear: "the king invites you to his son's wedding!" in a little while the king comes in and you see him pointing to a man who isn't dressed neatly, and hasn't washed his face or brushed his hair. he sends the man out of the hall. this is the story that jesus told about the kingdom of heaven. many important people have been invited, but they have decided that they were too busy with other things. but the king has invited us too! we should rejoice and "dress" our souls by being the best we can be! don't be a half-hearted christian! he might ask "why aren't you properly dressed?" answer to front page: everyone's invited! answers to 1. false; 2. true; 3. true; 4. true; 5. true; 6. true; 7. true.
